description: agent-action checked live after its delegation expired, carrying a signed_at inside the delegation's window — a live verifier MUST reject with E_EXPIRED per SPEC §8.1 step 6

expected.rejection_reason: Verified at 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z; v01 expired at 2026-04-29T12:00:00Z. A live verifier checks the delegation at the time of verification, so the action is refused whatever signed_at it carries. Step 6 comes before step 11a, so E_EXPIRED is reported rather than E_STALE.
